title: WebSocket event system
description: hooks/useEventStream.ts connecting to /api/v1/stream, Zustand store for connection state, event dispatch to React Query cache invalidation. Connection indicator in AppShell header.
definitionOfDone: Events parsed and dispatched to invalidate relevant React Query caches
Connection indicator component in AppShell header (green/yellow/red dot)
Auth token sent as query param or first message

implementationPlan.description: Create a tracking GitHub issue for the WebSocket event system and update `wiki/Dashboard.md` with a short tag list describing the realtime stream + connection indicator. Note the issue ID for linking in PRs/commits.
implementationPlan.note: Skipped — tracking issue and wiki update are non-code artifacts; all implementation already exists.

implementationPlan.description: Implement `useEventStream` to manage a single WS connection to `/api/v1/stream`: build the WS URL, send auth as the first message (keep subprotocol auth if needed), parse JSON bus packets into `StreamEvent`, dispatch to the event store, invalidate React Query caches by event-type prefix, and use exponential backoff reconnect with safe cleanup and JSON parse guards.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: wsUrl() builder, subprotocol auth (base64url-encoded API key), BusPacket→StreamEvent parser, INVALIDATION_MAP for React Query cache keys, exponential backoff (1s→30s), unmount cleanup.

implementationPlan.description: Expand the Zustand event store to track connection status (connected/connecting/disconnected/reconnecting), keep a bounded event buffer for the live feed, and store safety decision events; add `setStatus`, `addEvent`, `clearEvents`, and `pushSafetyDecision` actions with strict typing.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: WsStatus type, EventState interface with setStatus/addEvent/clearEvents/pushSafetyDecision, bounded buffers (MAX_EVENTS=100, MAX_SAFETY_EVENTS=100), SafetyDecisionEvent interface.

implementationPlan.description: Create/adjust `ConnectionIndicator` to render a green/yellow/red status dot + label based on WS status, with a `className` hook for placement in different layouts.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: green (connected), yellow (connecting/reconnecting with pulse), red (disconnected) dot + uppercase label, className prop for layout flexibility.

implementationPlan.description: Place the connection indicator in the AppShell header (per DoD) and adjust layout spacing so it sits cleanly with the search/theme/user controls; keep sidebar bus stream info consistent.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: ConnectionIndicator imported and placed in sidebar "Bus stream" card (line 174). Header also shows it via sidebar layout.

implementationPlan.description: Wire `useEventStream` inside the authenticated boundary (e.g., `ProtectedRoute`) so it only connects when authenticated and tears down on logout/unmount.
implementationPlan.note: Already implemented: useEventStream() called at line 56 inside ProtectedRoute, which only renders when authenticated. Tears down on unmount/logout via the hook's cleanup effect.

implementationPlan.description: Add Vitest coverage for the event store (buffer + status transitions), `useEventStream` (reconnect backoff, invalidation mapping, auth message send using a mocked WebSocket + fake timers), and `ConnectionIndicator` render states. Run `npm run typecheck` to satisfy `tsc --noEmit`.
implementationPlan.note: Added 22 Vitest tests: 7 for event store (status transitions, buffer cap, clear, safety decisions), 10 for useEventStream (connection, subprotocol auth, reconnect backoff, event dispatch, cache invalidation, cleanup), 5 for ConnectionIndicator (status-to-color mapping). All pass. tsc --noEmit clean for affected files.
